exposure: Group 1 (low anxiety), Group 2 (mild anxiety), Group 3 (high anxiety), Group 4 (very high anxiety)
Group 1 (low depression), Group 2 (mild depression), Group 3 (high depression)
outcome: Patterns of co-occurrence of depressive and anxiety symptoms
cohort: 139 childbearing women who underwent an elective cesarean section
finding: The study identified three distinct trajectories of depressive symptoms and four of anxiety symptoms in women who underwent elective cesarean section, finding that mild symptoms of both were the most common joint trajectory and that the trajectories were significantly related.
mod_finding: This study examined trajectories of depression and anxiety in women who underwent an elective cesarean section but did not report findings related to mode of delivery.
